name_zh: 罗马尼亚·科德雷亚努：铁卫团法西斯神秘正教青年
name_en: Romania Corneliu Codreanu: Iron Guard Fascism Mysticism Orthodoxy Youth
description_zh: 科内留·泽利亚·科德雷亚努 (1899-1938) 铁卫团创始人，融合法西斯主义、东正教神秘主义、反犹太主义、青年运动，建立死亡军团崇拜牺牲精神，1938年被卡罗尔二世枪杀，成为极右翼殉道符号。
description_en: Corneliu Zelea Codreanu (1899-1938) Iron Guard founder, fused fascism, Orthodox mysticism, anti-Semitism, youth movement, built Death Legion cult of sacrifice, 1938 executed by Carol II, became far-right martyr symbol.
reason_zh: 科德雷亚努代表战间期东欧法西斯主义的宗教化变体，展示了正教神秘主义如何与极右翼意识形态结合，产生独特的青年动员与牺牲崇拜模式。
reason_en: Codreanu represents interwar Eastern European fascism religious variant, demonstrating how Orthodox mysticism fuses with far-right ideology creating unique youth mobilization and sacrifice cult pattern.
steps_zh: 研究科德雷亚努早年极右翼活动与铁卫团创建
分析正教神秘主义与法西斯仪式融合机制
探讨死亡军团牺牲崇拜与青年动员策略
评估1938年卡罗尔二世枪杀与殉道符号建构
总结铁卫团遗产在战后罗马尼亚极右翼复苏
steps_en: Study Codreanu early far-right activity and Iron Guard creation
Analyze Orthodox mysticism and fascist ritual fusion mechanism
Explore Death Legion sacrifice cult and youth mobilization strategy
Evaluate 1938 Carol II execution and martyr symbol construction
Summarize Iron Guard legacy in post-war Romanian far-right revival
expected_zh: 理解宗教神秘主义如何为法西斯主义提供精神动力，掌握青年牺牲崇拜动员机制，评估其对当代东欧极右翼意识形态的历史渊源。
expected_en: Understand how religious mysticism empowers fascism spiritually, grasp youth sacrifice cult mobilization mechanism, evaluate its historical roots for contemporary Eastern European far-right ideology.
case_zh: 1927 铁卫团前身创建；1930 铁卫团正式成立；1938 科德雷亚努被枪杀；战后铁卫团地下抵抗共产主义。法西斯神秘正教青年永存。
case_en: 1927 Iron Guard predecessor created; 1930 Iron Guard formally established; 1938 Codreanu executed; post-war Iron Guard underground resisted communism. Fascism mysticism orthodoxy youth endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Religious fascism variant; youth sacrifice cult; far-right martyr symbol
